result.name: publish_site
result.description: Publish the exact ready draft when the user asks to deploy, publish or take the website live (部署、上线、发布), unless publication was explicitly deferred. Reuse actionId on recovery; do not publish for status-only or preview-only requests. Read get_publish_status for the final publication state and site URL. CLI/Wake return that delivery result directly; Desktop may open its preview MCP after verification. To restore access to a suspended site's current publication, use resume_site instead.
